context_for_next_testing_agent: Both headline features (Fix Mapping UI, Category Master) are fully implemented and verified working live end-to-end this session - no gaps found. One design nuance worth main agent's awareness (not filed as a bug since it matches documented backend behavior): POST /part-overrides calls save_part_override() BEFORE checking if the override actually resolves, so even a failed 'Save & Retry' attempt (e.g. typing a typo'd SAP ID) permanently overwrites any previous override for that part_no in Mongo - if a user tries a wrong ID then a right one, this works fine (last write wins, matches UI flow), but if a user has a working override and later a colleague fat-fingers a bad one on the same part_no, the working mapping is silently lost until someone fixes it again. Purely a product/UX consideration, not a functional bug - the UI correctly reflects Mongo state and lets a user retry indefinitely.
